feature_contract.goal: Keep the original 6th/6 animated first-position SpriteNode and all clipped digit siblings on a correct R84 stereo HUD owner when their priority list survives the original native call, rejecting detached or reattached foreign queue tails rather than misassigning binocular ScreenHud ownership.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: Only original rank display 0x4B9D80 two native sprite families, their priority roots and native R84 ScreenHud queue registration; excludes vehicle-attached rank, +TIME, GOAL, ESC, F11, lens, SkyGlow, DX11, DXVK, R26_SAFE and original input/FFB.
trace_stages: Original 0x4B9D80 first animated rank sprite 0x29530 and right-side clipped digits enter DispRankFirst_sprani and DispRankRight_putClipSprite.
Original sprite callbacks may append multiple sibling nodes or replace the priority root; both wrappers snapshot root and tail before the native call.

TagAppendedNodes proves the same live root, reachable old tail and final new tail, then attaches ScreenHud only to the newly appended 6th/6 SpriteNodes for separately gated R84 left/right GPU submission.
subcomponents: Protect the rank first animated sprite batch by capturing all original priority roots and requiring stable live-root plus bounded old/new tail proof before tagging.
Protect the right-side rank digit clip batch with the same original root proof, including all valid sibling nodes and the empty sentinel first-write case.
Compile-time positive and negative native queue fixtures for root reuse, detached tail, foreign last tail and bounded cyclic list, preserving original rendering fallback.

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Only real SpriteNodes appended to the same priority root receive the original rank HUD semantic owner across multi-sibling and empty-sentinel cases.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: Rebuilt native priority root, reused old tail, detached and cyclic queue
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Foreign or recycled nodes are never dereferenced through a stale old tail or assigned rank HUD ownership; unverified native fallback stays unchanged.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: Windows native x86 R84 game, x64 OpenXR host, R26_SAFE package, Domain, HUD Inspector and Full Source Impact
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Four mandatory GitHub Actions succeed on one exact validation-bearing SHA with runtime Quest3 and VDXR untested.

diagnosis.original_evidence: Current GitHub source showed original 6th/6 DispRankFirst_sprani and DispRankRight_putClipSprite used an O(1) oldTail->next_0 branch without a stable priority root check.
source_trace: Original 0x4B9D80 first sprite and rank digits call native sprani and clip-sprite wrappers, capturing only tail_4 before C2.
Unverified O(1) TagAppendedNodes reads the captured old tail and can wrongly inherit ScreenHud if old-tail memory is reused or the priority root changes.
Modified exact two-family wrappers now capture root and tail and invoke the preexisting bounded stable-root verifier before R84 HUD tagging.
alternatives_rejected: No global retag of 2D content, no vehicle-attached rank flattening and no bypass of R84 conservative physical eye admission; other visual symptoms are independent.
diagnosis.eye_ownership: This fix limits which original queued rank nodes may be offered to native R84 ScreenHud stereo; successful Quest3 left/right output remains unproven.
diagnosis.root_cause: Rank first and digit wrappers previously fell through TagAppendedNodes ordinary O(1) dereference despite the native producer being able to rebuild or relink its priority list.
